review.notes: Full review. All 11 sampled targets (1.1-3.4) and all 13 headline theorems instantiated and recomputed numerically, including every counterexample Check; values agree. O'Donnell (arXiv:2105.10386v1) and DLMF 18.18.28 locators read and confirmed (10 of 27); the 17 locators into van Handel's lecture notes could not be read (sources service refused the address) and are listed as not verifiable. 24 library declarations opened at the pins; 11 cross-roadmap citations resolved; dependency check clean (0 problems); Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; one-tactic probe closes none of the 13 theorems; elaborated signatures agree with the README. The worker's automatic checks all passed. Two small corrections (Tau Ceti already has lower semicontinuity of klDiv; the comparison with OptimalTransport 11.9 is unowned) and one format note. For the humans: van Handel's notes are unpublished and unread; later Tau Ceti versions reportedly contain a one-dimensional Mehler operator.
